title: Add a reusable legacy-vs-generic four-dimension parity comparator over bounded result snapshots
description: Stage 2 gap: the migration registry only derives preset-ready from DECLARED metadata (SemanticsMatch compares RequiredMenuCodes + CurrencyUnitSemantics strings, ReportMigrationRegistry.cs:172-183) and never compares ACTUAL legacy output against generic output. ReportMigrationParityEvidenceDto (ReportMigrationRegistryDtos.cs:107-116) declares four dimensions (DataGrainMatched/CurrencyUnitMatched/PermissionsMatched/OutputSemanticsMatched) but no code ever constructs it; only EmptyReportMigrationParityEvidenceProvider returns null (ReportMigrationRegistry.cs:262-270). Build a reusable, generic comparator that takes a bounded legacy result snapshot and a bounded generic preview snapshot and computes the data-grain (column keys/types + row keys + null-aware cell values), currency/unit (per-partition currencies/units never merged) and permissions (current-user row ownership/data-scope equivalence) dimensions, returning ReportMigrationParityEvidenceDto plus a deterministic mismatch detail list. OutputSemanticsMatched is supplied by the separate output-comparator seam built later. Pure read-only comparison over existing entities: no per-report controller/designer/exporter, no arbitrary SQL/joins, no new schema/entity, no permission expansion, no secrets/env. No new Domain entity or Api endpoint is required (existing migration-registry endpoint already surfaces the derived parity).
acceptance_criteria: A new reusable comparator interface + implementation compares a bounded legacy result snapshot (ordered columns with key/type/currency/unit and rows) against a bounded generic preview snapshot and returns ReportMigrationParityEvidenceDto with DataGrainMatched/CurrencyUnitMatched/PermissionsMatched computed, plus a deterministic mismatch detail list (column key/type/row/currency/unit/scope), without touching the database or expanding permissions.

Data grain matching is exact: column keys and types must align, row counts and stable row keys must match, and cell values compare null-aware (null == null, values compared by declared type); currency/unit matching fails closed whenever the same row/group would merge across currencies or units on one side but not the other; permissions matching compares current-user row ownership/data-scope equivalence and fails closed on any divergence.

Add executable unit coverage for equal/unequal columns, row-key mismatches, null-aware cell equality, cross-currency/unit merge rejection and data-scope divergence, with no regression in existing ReportMigrationRegistryTests; the safe Release build/unit suite and scheduler self-test/contracts pass.
implementation_evidence: src/ERP.Application/Services/ReportMigrationRegistry.cs:172-183 SemanticsMatch only compares declared RequiredMenuCodes and CurrencyUnitSemantics strings, never actual data; :114-120 DeriveParityAsync consumes _evidence.GetEvidence and stays PresetReady when evidence is null/not Complete. src/ERP.Application/DTOs/ReportMigrationRegistryDtos.cs:107-116 declares ReportMigrationParityEvidenceDto (DataGrainMatched/CurrencyUnitMatched/PermissionsMatched/OutputSemanticsMatched, Complete = all four) but no type constructs it; search for ReportMigrationParityComparator yields no results. src/ERP.Application/Services/ReportMigrationRegistry.cs:262-270 EmptyReportMigrationParityEvidenceProvider.GetEvidence always returns null; src/ERP.Infrastructure/DependencyInjection.cs:142 registers that empty singleton.
